alt: Four stages: observe an input and failure, reproduce with a failing test, repair with a small diff, and review the final revision.
caption: A bounded handoff retains the original failure and tests the final revision. See C06 and C16.

alt: Two separate records: Dots has a launch notice dated 29 September 2026. Codex CLI has living documentation and separately dated releases.
caption: Dots and Codex CLI are distinct products with separate records. See P03 and P06.

alt: Four layers to inspect: instruction scope, skill or plugin files and version, MCP server tools and access, and source content as evidence.
caption: Review each layer before use. Source content supplies evidence and does not grant permission.

alt: A newsletter workflow has two paths. Research supports editorial review and an issue draft. Sales research supports a sponsor worklist and a human decision.
caption: Howell describes research and sales agents for a local newsletter. Human review is a proposed boundary. See O01.

alt: A matrix distinguishes file inspection, local report drafts, and publication. Each task requires a different access boundary.
caption: Start with the smallest access needed for the task. A read tool and a write tool have different effects.

alt: A missing source leaves a claim unverified. Two reports that repeat one interview count as one evidence origin.
caption: A missing citation and repeated coverage are different problems. Check the original source.

alt: A test fails on the original revision, passes on the candidate, and runs again on the final revision.
caption: The reviewed revision must match the tested revision. Record any skipped checks.

alt: A claim and source enter an audit. If the source supports the claim, keep the citation. Otherwise, repair or remove the claim.
caption: Compare each claim with the cited source. Record checks that remain incomplete.

alt: Three inputs feed a launch brief: launch date, a missing QA owner, and pending approval.
caption: The brief must preserve missing ownership and pending approval. No send is authorized.

alt: Codex CLI and Antigravity app versions have separate source records. Preserve the baseline if a source is unavailable.
caption: Check the app version against the app changelog. Keep alpha releases separate.

alt: Two report inputs have expected totals: an empty list returns zero and 100 plus 250 returns 350.
caption: Use both cases to check the local repair. Record the initial failure and final test results.

alt: Two excerpts support a table of announcement dates, surfaces, and access. Unstated access is marked Not in source.
caption: Compare the source text for each row. An announced rollout does not establish access for a particular account.

alt: A form check links labels to fields and checks whether keyboard focus is visible at two viewport widths.
caption: Use the local preview to inspect both widths. Record viewport checks as pending if browser access fails.

alt: A vendor request leads to a draft reply, a newsletter is informational, and a mock call becomes a brief entry.
caption: Use synthetic messages and a sandbox mailbox. Stop before any external action.

alt: Tan reports that Tibot filters mentions and keywords into a scheduled digest. She says she writes her own posts.
caption: This describes Tan’s public account. Accuracy, cost, and complete configuration remain unverified. See C21.

alt: An annotated debug prompt names the failing command and revision, limits changes, requires repeat checks, and defines a stop condition.
caption: Supply actual failure evidence. A vague request such as “fix it” cannot identify the behavior to preserve.

alt: A baseline and a candidate feed the same evaluation metric. Comparable inputs make the comparison meaningful.
caption: A baseline provides a comparator. An evaluation metric states how the outputs are scored.

alt: Three study routes offer a quick workflow, standard practice and checks, or a deeper comparison and audit.
caption: Choose the route that fits the outcome. Return to a shorter route when a prerequisite needs practice.

alt: One fixed diff feeds a fresh reviewer. A concrete finding returns to the author for a repair and rerun. A clean review goes to a human decision.
caption: In this local adaptation, both branches start with the same diff. Each review finding must point to a line or a test.
